name: Two Heads Are Better
body:
Through clever self-wounding and a strong force of will, you have can use your regeneration ability to grow an additional head.

Prerequisite(s): Armed and Dangerous, troll level 5th.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can force your regeneration into overdrive, carefully severing your own head and reattaching it as a new one grows. This second head grants you a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks, and you cannot be flanked while the second head is grown. Your second head remains grown until you sever one or both heads, a full-round action that causes you no ill effects. After you use this feat, your regeneration is suppressed for one round.
